metadata: Only quiz_exclusions appended in exact order. All other metadata semantically identical; 羊 unchanged.

notesAdditions.衛:
- [援](援.md) receives a direct precaution for protective aid or
  rescue; general assistance and cheering are not necessarily defense.
  [循](循.md) receives one for going around. Daijisen's circling branch
  and the historical メグル lookup are not restricted to satellites.
- [番](番.md) also means watch or guard; its numbering sense is separate.
  [士](士.md) and [軍](軍.md) receive qualified military-guard precautions,
  not a claim that every professional, warrior or army is a guard.
- [送](送.md) receives a precaution for a protective escort, not every
  act of sending or seeing someone off. [抵](抵.md) receives one for
  warding off or resisting an attack. Whole-word 護衛 and 衛護 do not
  make every escort sense an unrestricted meaning of bare 衛.
notesAdditions.霜:
- [氷](氷.md) and [凍](凍.md) receive direct precautions: Daijisen
  defines deposited frost crystals and refrigerator frost as ice.
  Frost is not every freezing event or every kind of ice.
- Weblio's 隠語大辞典 records bare 霜しも for alcoholic drinks,
  prompting a qualified [酒](酒.md) precaution. This compilation retains
  Meiji-and-later jargon, not proof of ordinary modern usage.
- [涼](涼.md) receives a broad cool/cold-comparison precaution;
  refreshing coolness and severe cold differ. [久](久.md) receives one
  for elapsed years, not because every interval is necessarily long.
- The positive historical loss/perishing branch also prompts qualified
  precautions with [害](害.md), [枯](枯.md), [殺](殺.md) and [卒](卒.md).
  Harm, withering, killing and life's ending are not identical.
  In particular, perish does not automatically mean cause death;
  this precaution retains uncertainty about the destructive branch,
  not an ordinary unrestricted "kill" meaning or a graduation sense.
